---
name: dotfiles-backup
description: Back up your shell and editor setup so you can restore it on a new machine in one step.
---

# Dotfiles backup

Use this when the user asks to back up, save, or move their setup to a new laptop.

1. Collect shell startup files, editor config, and git config. Skip anything that holds login state or keys (cloud, container and SSH folders, .env files, token files); list what was skipped.
2. Show the user the file list and ask which repository to use. Push only to a private repository the user names under their own account.
3. Reply with the restore command and the skipped-file list.
